author: sjm41
body:
**UniProt UniRule (ID and label):**
UR000375979

**Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Q86BL4  Dmel GatC
O43716 Human GATC
etc

**Description of issue**
UR000375979 is based on HAMAP signature MF_00122, which is specifically for the GatC protein.

UR000375979 adds catalytic annotations including:
- RHEA:17521
- GO:0016884   carbon-nitrogen ligase activity, with glutamine as amido-N-donor
- GO:0050567   glutaminyl-tRNA synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity

But the GATC subunit is not catalytic, and instead is required for the proper folding of the catalytic A and B subunits. (e.g. see PMID: 16809541, PMID:24579914.)

So I think the catalytic annotations should be removed from this rule.
title: Incorrect Unirule mapping: UR000375979

author: sjm41
body:

author: alanbridge
body:
Hi Steve, 

Ivo Pedruzzi at Swiss-Prot ( @pedruzzi ) would be the person to contact as this is a HAMAP rule (HAMAP being incorporated by the UniRule system), and so needs to be fixed at source by the HAMAP curators at SIB here: https://hamap.expasy.org/rule/MF_03149

Cheers, Alan

author: cmungall
body: We have github issue templates set up, such that when someone comes to submit a new request, they see once they select one, an assignee is auto-assigned This is the template for unirule: https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/report-unirule-issues.md @PedroRaposo is the assignee Usually we have one template per GO_REF, but as unirule is an amalgam we could in theory have special unirule-hamap template with this auto-assigned to @pedruzzi. We'll take care of the conf, we just need to know from you who should be assigned what!

author: sjm41
body:
Hi @pedruzzi 
Just checking if you have an update on this?
Thanks.

author: pedruzzi
body:
Yes, sorry it took a while, but we are making a complete overhaul of the 6 rules involved (3 rules for each subunit A, B and C for prokaryotes and eukaryotes, respectively). RHEA:17521 is a multistep reaction, and reactions for the different steps have been created and can be assigned to the different subunits (i.e. A and B). We have updated the annotations/rules to reflect this and are currently applying this to the ~1700 concerned SP entries before going public. This should be done by latest end of next week. I have already removed the EC, Rhea and GO terms from the rules for subunit C, but I don't know how long it will take to trickle down into the public releases.
Best
-ivo
